title: Juniper and the Second Lantern
youtube_title: Juniper and the Second Lantern | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Wonder grows when you look closely and let the world show you its quiet copies.
summary: On the town lantern walk, Juniper sees the canal holding copies of the lights and hears the bridge gently returning the flute's notes. She crosses twice, slowly, just to watch and listen.
